title: Dispatch: Bag of Tricks color variants + engine-rolled d8 creature bound to the use (attempt 1, Sonnet)
description:
Implementation dispatch for eshyra-olc5.16 (Sonnet 5.5). Worktree .worktrees/eshyra-olc5.16.1, branch eshyra-olc5.16.1 (cut from eshyra-olc5.16 = origin/main 2f747ddf). Deps installed. Read `bd show eshyra-olc5.16` (owning spec), AGENTS.md, docs/importer-fix-protocol.md BEFORE editing. This follows the olc5.14 Horn of Valhalla pattern exactly: study `git show b0dd7111 --stat` and the diff of 0a796c7d..b0dd7111 (Horn variants + engine-rolled countRoll on the bind credit) and copy its idioms.

SOURCE (SRD 5.1 p. 210-211): "This ordinary bag, made from gray, rust, or tan cloth ... it transforms into a creature you determine by rolling a d8 and consulting the table that corresponds to the bag's color." Tables table:gray-bag-of-tricks / rust / tan (columns d8 | Creature, rows 1..8). All 24 creatures exist as creature:<kebab> records (weasel, giant-rat, badger, boar, panther, giant-badger, dire-wolf, giant-elk; rat, owl, mastiff, goat, giant-goat, giant-boar, lion, brown-bear; jackal, ape, baboon, axe-beak, black-bear, giant-weasel, giant-hyena, tiger).

DECISIONS (made by the supervisor; implement, do not redesign):
D1 Bag color = magic-item VARIANT (persistent per instance). In parseMagicItems.ts add extractBagOfTricksVariants beside extractHornOfValhallaVariants: variants Gray, Rust, Tan (ids gray/rust/tan), rarity 'Uncommon' (match the record's rarity spelling/case the Horn variants use), text 'd8 creatures: 1 Weasel; 2 Giant rat; ...' built from a pinned BAG_OF_TRICKS_TABLES constant. Abort extraction if the description no longer contains 'made from gray, rust, or tan cloth' or the d8 phrase. Add assertBagOfTricksTablesMatch (like assertHornOfValhallaTypesMatchTable) called from emit.ts magicItemExtractionsToRecords under compileExecutableSemantics, checking all three emitted tables' columns ['d8','Creature'] and rows against the pinned constant.
D2 Grants (magicItemEntityGrants.ts, the 'Bag of Tricks' SPEC ~line 186): replace the single bag-creature grant with three grants `gray-bag-creature`, `rust-bag-creature`, `tan-bag-creature`, each: kind creature, variants [color], creatureRefs = the 8 creature refs IN d8 ROW ORDER, tableRefs [that color's table only], creatureRoll '1d8', count 1, revertOn ['next-dawn','reduced-to-0-hit-points'], cooldownEconomy 'uses'. Keep existing sourcePhrases/control span handling. Grant ids must stay unique and stable.
D3 New grant field `creatureRoll` (src/rules/magicItemMechanics.ts MagicItemEntityGrant + the entityGrant validator's allowed-key list and checks, beside countRoll): a dice expression '1dN' the ENGINE rolls once per use; valid only on kind 'creature'; requires creatureRefs with exactly N entries (N >= 2), no statBlockRef, a numeric count of 1, and is mutually exclusive with countRoll. Row k of the roll selects creatureRefs[k-1]. Doc-comment it like countRoll.
D4 Persistence: new migration (next number after 0050_item_grant_bind_credit_rolled_counts.sql, same directory) adding `rolled_creatures_json TEXT` to item_grant_bind_credit; update data/schema.snapshot.sql and any migration-number pins exactly as olc5.14 did (persistence.test.ts, migrationLegacyAdoption.test.ts). In itemGrantBinding.ts: `ItemGrantRolledCreature {grantId, notation, roll, creatureRef}`, issueItemGrantBindCredit accepts rolledCreatures, `readItemGrantRolledCreature(db, creditId, grantId)` that never throws and returns undefined for absent/malformed values (mirror readItemGrantRolledCount, validate roll is an integer within 1..N and creatureRef is a string).
D5 use_item (src/state/itemState.ts issueBindCredits, beside the countRoll loop): for each listed grant with creatureRoll, require args.input.rng (same refusal wording pattern), rollDice('1dN'), creatureRef = creatureRefs[total-1], persist on the credit, and return it on the hint credit as `rolledCreatures: [{grantId, notation, roll, creatureRef}]` (add to UseItemResult type). Because only variant-admitted grants are listed, a gray bag's credit lists only gray-bag-creature.
D6 Binder (src/state/activeEffects.ts validateItemGrantBinding): a grant with creatureRoll REQUIRES source.bindCreditId (same check/wording style as countRoll: 'summons a rolled creature ... belongs to one use'); read the rolled creature for (bindCreditId, grantId); refuse if absent; then every linked actor's encounter_combatant.rules_ref must equal that creatureRef OR match its record name (reuse grantAdmitsCreature with a synthetic grant `{creatureRefs:[selected]}` — NO tableRefs, so a different row of the same table is refused). The generic tableRefs name match must NOT admit other rows for a creatureRoll grant: perform the rolled check instead of (not in addition to) the generic admit for such grants. Error: `linked actor 'X' is creature:Y; use 'credit' rolled d8 = k: creature:Z`.
D7 Ownership (scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/magicItemGrantOwnership.ts creatureGrantLifecycleOwned): oneCreature also holds when grant.creatureRoll is a string matching /^1d(\d+)$/ with creatureRefs.length === N and statBlockRef undefined. Update its doc comment (Bag of Tricks now binds the color as variant and the d8 per use; the Elemental Gem stays pending until eshyra-xt6m.1). Update magicItemGrantOwnership.test.ts owned/kept sets and add a counterfactual (creatureRoll with mismatched N is not owned; a multi-creature grant without creatureRoll is not owned).
D8 Tool descriptions: give_item (toolGiveItem.ts): a Bag of Tricks is given with its cloth color as variantId (gray, rust or tan; fixed for that bag; the DM chooses it). use_item (toolUseItem.ts): a listed grant whose creature is rolled (Bag of Tricks) carries the engine's d8 in the credit's rolledCreatures [{grantId, notation, roll, creatureRef}]: bind exactly that creature and pass that creditId as start_effect source.bindCreditId. start_effect (toolStartEffect.ts): extend the countRoll sentence to cover a rolled creature.
D9 Regenerate the canonical pack: `npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/` (the default --out is a scratch path!), then `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`. Regenerate the semi-structured inventory (docs/audits/.../o9bd-18-8-8-semi-structured-boundary.{json,md}) by calling writeCommittedOutputs() from packages/core/scripts/inventory-semi-structured-boundary.ts through a small tsx script in your scratch area (not committed). Write a thaw note docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/thaw-notes/2026-10-31-eshyra-olc5-16-1-bag-of-tricks-color-and-d8.md in the format of 2026-10-26-eshyra-7gkh-1-dawn-economy-readiness.md (reason, expected file changes, generated change with exact before->after readiness counts and newly ready operations).
D10 Readiness pins: m4-bag-of-tricks should become green again (owned) and pull-fuzzy-object ready again. Update srdGeneratedPack.test.ts count pins to the ACTUAL regenerated numbers (currently 763 pending / 254 green / 366 adjudicated / 1384 total; expect roughly pending -1, green +1 — report exact values), add Bag back to the READY list in magicItemOperationSourceAgreement.test.ts and to CONFORMANCE_BACKED in itemGrantRealPackReadiness.test.ts (it was removed by PR #690 when its readiness was held). Never weaken any other pin.

EVIDENCE (real pack, unmodified, no readiness waiver; follow itemGrantRolledCount.test.ts and itemGrantRealPackReadiness.test.ts helpers):
 E1 give_item a gray Bag of Tricks; use_item pull-fuzzy-object with a seeded rng -> the credit lists only gray-bag-creature and rolledCreatures with roll k and creatureRef = gray row k; start_effect binds a combatant of that creature (with campaignActorId per PR #690 durability rule) with source.bindCreditId -> succeeds.
 E2 refusals on the same setup: another gray row's creature; a rust-table creature (bind gray-bag-creature with a rust creature, and bind rust-bag-creature on a gray bag -> variant refusal); missing source.bindCreditId; an unrelated/other instance's credit; a second bind of the same credit.
 E3 three uses then a fourth refused (uses economy) still holds; dawn restores (only if not already covered — check itemPerDayDawnEconomy.test.ts; do not duplicate).
 E4 importer/validator: creatureRoll validator refusals (non-creature, N mismatch, with countRoll, with statBlockRef) in the mechanics validator's existing test file; the table-pin assert aborts on a drifted row (unit-level, like hornOfValhallaVariants.test.ts — put Bag cases in a new bagOfTricksVariants.test.ts beside it).
 Negative-proof each new binder/ownership assertion once (break, see it fail, restore) and list them in your report.

NOT REQUIRED / DO NOT: a generic table-selection engine; touching the Elemental Gem or Horn semantics; placement/commands (DM); weakening any test.

PROCESS: implement; from the worktree root run `npm run verify:worktree` (rewrites files) and it must pass BEFORE committing; commit on eshyra-olc5.16.1 (message starts 'eshyra-olc5.16.1', ends with `Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>`); report via `bd update eshyra-olc5.16.1 --append-notes "..."` (files, decisions, exact count deltas, newly ready operations, negative proofs, verify result); file follow-ups with bd create; `bd close eshyra-olc5.16.1`.

SUPERVISOR ADDENDUM: your migration is 0051 (a parallel dispatch may take 0052). In toolGiveItem.ts edit only the description string; a parallel dispatch appends one sentence to the Horn sentence there.
COMPLETE commit ed355686 on eshyra-olc5.16.1 (verify:worktree exit 0; 380 files/7142 tests passed, 3 skipped). D1-D10 per plan. Files: parseMagicItems.ts (BAG_OF_TRICKS_TABLES, extractBagOfTricksVariants, assertBagOfTricksTablesMatch), emit.ts, magicItemEntityGrants.ts (3 grants), magicItemGrantOwnership.ts, magicItemTriage.ts (creatureRoll kept), magicItemMechanics.ts (creatureRoll validator), migration 0051_item_grant_bind_credit_rolled_creatures.sql + schema.snapshot, itemGrantBinding.ts (ItemGrantRolledCreature, readItemGrantRolledCreature), itemState.ts (d8 roll at issueBindCredits, rolledCreatures in hint), activeEffects.ts (bindCreditId required, rolled check), tool descriptions (give/use/start_effect), regenerated records.json + semi-structured inventory, thaw note 2026-10-31-eshyra-olc5-16-1-bag-of-tricks-color-and-d8.md. READINESS: pending 763->762, green 254->255, adjudicated 366->367, design-blocked 1, total 1384->1385. Newly ready: Bag of Tricks pull-fuzzy-object (3 variant rows gray/rust/tan in operation-source-agreement READY; 1 in itemGrantRealPackReadiness CONFORMANCE_BACKED). Deviations/notes: (1) rolled-creature check uses synthetic grant {creatureRefs:[sel], statBlockRef: sel} so the printed-name match works (grantAdmitsCreature only name-matches via statBlockRef); no tableRefs. (2) Numeric conservation gate: added exception magic-item:bag-of-tricks|parent|reverse|1d8 (prose 'a d8' vs typed 1d8); audit variants missingCount 235->234. (3) Existing Bag tests rewritten to real use_item flow (itemGrantRealPackReadiness; itemGrantSummons S7 + table-row test; itemGrantBindCredit ordering/scoping tests moved from Bag to Pipes of the Sewers, which has a fixed creature; rolled carriers excluded from generic carrier loop; test/support/bindCredit.ts scaffold skips creatureRoll grants). New tests: itemGrantBagOfTricks.test.ts (E1,E2,E3 fourth pull refused, tamper cases), bagOfTricksVariants.test.ts (E4 table-pin aborts), magicItemMechanicsSchema (creatureRoll refusals), magicItemGrantOwnership counterfactuals. NEGATIVE PROOFS (break, saw fail, restored): rolled check admits any grant creatureRef -> sibling-row refusal test fails; bindCreditId not required -> unnamed-credit test fails; rolled check removed entirely -> 2 binder tests fail; ownership N unchecked / statBlockRef allowed / creatureRoll branch dropped -> counterfactual test fails. NOTE: skipping the generic grantAdmitsCreature for creatureRoll grants is redundant for safety (the rolled check runs after and narrows), it only fixes which error message wins; removing the skip did not fail a test (not asserted: it is defense-in-depth per D6).
